title: Blanche Calloway fronting the band and who played in it
summary: Blanche Calloway fronted the band for theatres and dances but did not write the arrangements; he lists members such as Clarence Smith, Abie Baker, Slim Moore and Stump Brady.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Take a band like the Blanche Calloway band. Was that mostly a show band or did they play a lot for dancing too?
We played for dances too. We played for theaters and dances.
Did she front the band as well as sing?
Yeah. She --
She had a baton.
She looked good in front of a band.
Huh. Was she the real leader or was there a musical director of some kind?
Was she what?
Was she the leader actually -- I mean did she select the music and stuff like that?

Did she write in any things? No, she didn't write none of the things. I guess she did a few -- several things. A couple of things. I don't know whether she did or who. Cause I didn't start with the band. I came in the band had been together for awhile. So I don't know who.. She had some guys in there that were real (inaudible).
-- real --
I guess Edgard Battle (PHONETIC) had been in the band somewhere along the line.

Yeah, he had been in there. Then he got a job with a show called "Puddin Head Jones" or something like that. And they had a guy that played trumpet named Smitty. Well known -- I mean he was known around -- great first trumpet player. Chan Smith --
What was his first name?
Clarence.
Clarence.
And he was good -- a good -- a great first trumpet player you know. I just don't remember all the guys that was in that band off hand.
Abie Baker (PHONETIC) -- he's still around.
Yeah, Abie Baker (PHONETIC) and his brother, Earle. And gee, I can't remember all the guys.
Slim Moore.
Yeah, Slim Moore. Other trombone player was Clyde Brady.
Stump -- Stumpy. You worked with him in some other bands --
Yeah, worked with him and Claude too. Claude Atkins (PHONETIC).
Yeah, he's still around.
And (inaudible). Or does he, I don't know. Better shut that off now --
